subject: Request for one-time auditor SSO + bridge letter and session rotation
messages:
From: Jamie Ellis <jamie.ellis@grant-audit.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechpartners.io>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-lived SSO for SOC 2 Type II evidence download

Marcus / Redwood team —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. As we prepare for Fintech Partners' SOC 2 Type II review (period: 2027-07-01 to 2028-03-31), we need temporary access to your Trust Portal to download the evidence bundle and a signed bridge letter that confirms the audit period. Two asks: 

1) One-time SSO link for two auditors (Jamie Ellis, jamie.ellis@grant-audit.com; and a backup Samir Patel) with download-only permissions. Desired window: 48 hours, ideally starting 2028-04-25 08:00 UTC. Please advise if local timezone windows are required.

2) A short bridge letter (PDF) that states Redwood's SOC 2 report covers the above audit period and notes any gaps/residual items. The bridge letter will be attached to our report pack.

We also need: auditor IP ranges for allowlist if applicable, any MFA requirements, and whether downloads will include evidence manifests (csv) with file hashes. If you can provide a one-time portal token and the bridge letter by EOD 2028-04-20 that would keep us on schedule.

Thanks — happy to provide any additional identification docs.

Best,
Jamie Ellis
Senior Auditor, Grant & Co.
jamie.ellis@grant-audit.com
+1 (415) 555-0211

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Ellis <jamie.ellis@grant-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-lived SSO for SOC 2 Type II evidence download

Jamie —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can do a download-only, one-time SSO session and prepare a signed bridge letter. A few confirmations so our ops team can provision correctly: 

- Confirm preferred start window: you requested 2028-04-25 08:00 UTC (we can make that start, window 48 hours). Confirm yes/no.
- Please confirm the auditor full legal names and emails for the user provisioning (Jamie Ellis / jamie.ellis@grant-audit.com; Samir Patel / samir.patel@fintechpartners.io).
- Any IP ranges to allowlist? If you do not have static IPs we can instead require a short-lived device code + MFA.
- Do you need the evidence manifest (CSV) with SHA256 hashes included? We can include it as part of the bundle.

I'll loop in Marissa (trust portal owner) and Neha (portal/admin) to create the one-time link and sign the bridge letter. Expect an internal confirmation once the link and signed PDF are staged.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0198

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jamie Ellis <jamie.ellis@grant-audit.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short-lived SSO for SOC 2 Type II evidence download

Neha —

Forwarding Jamie's request. Please provision a one-time, download-only SSO session for the two auditors below with the following constraints:

- Window: 2028-04-25 08:00 UTC -> 2028-04-27 08:00 UTC (48 hours)
- Role: read-only / download-only on "Fintech Partners - SOC2 Evidence" folder
- Expire token at window end, revoke any active sessions after the window
- Require MFA verification at first sign-in; do NOT allow account creation or permission escalation
- If auditor IP ranges are provided we will add them to the allowlist; otherwise, require MFA + signed device token
- Generate an evidence_manifest.csv that includes filenames + SHA256 hashes and include in the bundle

I'll attach the bridge letter once Security signs it. Please include these attachments in the staged bundle: redwood_bridge_letter_20280411.pdf (signed), evidence_manifest_2028-04-11.csv. Also create a short portal token file portal_one_time_link_token.txt containing the one-time URL and expiry.

Let me know if you need legal sign-off or if there's a problem with the date window. Marcus — please confirm auditor emails so Neha can provision.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Trust Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: short-lived SSO for SOC 2 Type II evidence download

Team —

Confirmed — the auditor emails are correct. Samir and I will use MFA on first sign-in. No static IPs on our side, so device token + MFA is fine.

Thanks for staging the artifacts. I received the portal token link and the bridge letter (redwood_bridge_letter_20280411.pdf). We were able to download the evidence bundle and the evidence_manifest_2028-04-11.csv (hashes included). Attached is a short receipt file (audit_access_receipt.txt) with timestamps of our downloads for your records.

One small ask for the manifest: can the manifest include a brief field "source_path" for each file (S3 object path) — that will help us map items to the control narratives. Not urgent for this pull, but if you can add it to future manifests that would be helpful.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this keeps Fintech Partners' report on schedule.

Best,
Jamie Ellis
Senior Auditor, Grant & Co.
